build_commands: gfortran -O2 -o driver1 d1mach.o lasys.o rfft_pack.o neuman.o driver1.o

claim.text: U(0.1112, 1.3695) from NEUMAN on data1 (boundary function 3, curve 1, EPS 1e-7, NTHETA 5, NR 10), as printed in the shipped RES1 (D format, 11 decimals). Registered tolerance abs 5e-12 (half unit of the printed 11th decimal).

attempt: Original Makefile target neuman failed as shipped: FC=epcf90, not on this host (exit 2). Build with gfortran 16 from the authors' sources, the Makefile's neuman commands run directly, with one source patch to d1mach.f (see patch). Diagnostics: unpatched d1mach.f gives the same value; -O0 build and a bounds/NaN-initialised build give the same value.

original_attempt.reason: Doc/Makefile sets FC=epcf90 (a compiler not on the sandbox PATH); make stops at the first compile with 'epcf90: No such file or directory'.

exact_test_function_at_point.method: python3 -I: x=R*cos(theta) etc from CURVE/driver formula, F=exp(x)*cos(y)-1 at the driver's own DPTS point (I=1,J=2 and its mirror)

second_pass.description: Different environment: -O0 build with no source patch to d1mach beyond the authors' documented block, and a bounds/NaN-init checked build (-fcheck=all -finit-real=snan). Same value to 11 digits, plus the analytic check above.

cause_detail: Not a build or tuning difference: the value disagrees with the analytic test function exp(x)cos(y)-1 (GVFCN NUMF=3) at the run's own point (x=0.111246117975, y=1.369521383465), which gives -0.776556878092. Our build agrees with that to 1e-11. The shipped RES1 is about 5.9e-8 away from that analytic value (within the requested EPS 1e-7) while its own ERROR column reports 7.8e-16, so the shipped reference output is internally inconsistent with its own test function. The cause of the shipped value (HP C200 build or run) is not established.
